title: Document Supabase Auth login in Swagger without adding a gateway/edge-function proxy

plan_refs.section: §1 what the gateway does not own (auth issuance/password flows)

goals.description: User asked for a POST /auth/login API connecting to Supabase, documented in Swagger, tested. Flagged that this duplicates the already-rolled-back 002 login proxy and violates §1 ownership; user chose: document Supabase's own login endpoint in Swagger UI, add no new code (gateway or edge function).

Add Supabase Auth's POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password as a reference-only path in openapi.yaml, scoped to the Supabase server (not the gateway's own server entry), clearly labeled as not served by this gateway
No changes to router.go or any Go handler — verify go build/vet/test still pass unchanged
Validate the new path renders correctly in Swagger UI (manual run + browser/curl check)
